cnTitle: 紫微在疾厄宫：脾胃是重点，操劳应酬别过度
enTitle: Zi Wei in the Health Palace: Digestion Takes Care
enDesc: Zi Wei belongs to earth, and in the Health Palace it often points to strain on the spleen, stomach and digestion. The constitution is usually not weak, but overwork, social dining and irregular meals can wear the stomach and gut down; rhythm and not forcing through matter most.
cnDesc: 紫微属土，在疾厄宫多指向脾胃、消化系统的负担；体质底子通常不弱，但容易因操劳、应酬、饮食不规律把肠胃拖出问题，重在有节律、别硬撑。

cnTitle: 天机在疾厄宫：肝胆神经偏敏感，想太多最伤身
enTitle: Tian Ji in the Health Palace: Nerves and Liver Need Calm
enDesc: Tian Ji belongs to wood, and in the Health Palace it often points to liver-gallbladder qi and the nervous system. Sensitive and prone to overthinking, one may face insomnia, tension and tight shoulders and neck; calming the mind and cutting inner friction help more than any tonic.
cnDesc: 天机属木，在疾厄宫多指向肝胆气机与神经系统；人偏敏感、思虑重，容易失眠、紧张、肩颈紧，养身先养心、少内耗，比补什么都管用。

cnTitle: 太阳在疾厄宫：心火上炎要留意，血压眼睛多关照
enTitle: Tai Yang in the Health Palace: Heart Fire, Pressure and Eyes
enDesc: Tai Yang belongs to fire, and in the Health Palace it often points to heart fire, blood pressure, cardiovascular-cerebral vessels and the eyes. Headaches, dry eyes and internal heat are common; avoid staying up and anger, eat lightly, check pressure regularly and do not ignore signals.
cnDesc: 太阳属火，在疾厄宫多指向心火、血压、心脑血管与眼睛；容易头痛、眼干、上火，重在别熬夜动怒、清淡饮食、定期量血压，信号别忽视。

cnTitle: 武曲在疾厄宫：呼吸道与牙齿偏弱，金属外伤要当心
enTitle: Wu Qu in the Health Palace: Respiratory Tract, Teeth and Injury
enDesc: Wu Qu belongs to metal, and in the Health Palace it often points to the lungs, respiratory tract, teeth and nose, and also advises care with metal and sharp-object injury. Protect yourself at season changes, keep up oral care, prevent bumps during work or exercise and treat wounds promptly.
cnDesc: 武曲属金，在疾厄宫多指向肺、呼吸道、牙齿与鼻腔，也提示留意金属、利器之伤；换季注意防护、口腔卫生勤做，运动劳作防磕碰，有外伤及时处理。

cnTitle: 天同在疾厄宫：水湿代谢偏慢，泌尿与糖分多留意
enTitle: Tian Tong in the Health Palace: Water Metabolism, Urinary and Sugar
enDesc: Tian Tong belongs to water, and in the Health Palace it often points to the urinary system, kidneys and bladder, water-dampness and sugar metabolism. The constitution tends to be deficient, prone to swelling and fatigue; exercise moderately, cut sweets and cold, avoid long sitting and check metabolic markers regularly.
cnDesc: 天同属水，在疾厄宫多指向泌尿、肾与膀胱、水湿和糖分代谢；体质偏虚、易水肿乏力，重在适度运动、少甜少凉、别久坐，代谢相关指标定期查。

cnTitle: 廉贞在疾厄宫：血液炎症要当心，起病急时别犹豫
enTitle: Lian Zhen in the Health Palace: Blood, Inflammation and Acute Onset
enDesc: Lian Zhen belongs to fire, and in the Health Palace it often points to blood, heart fire and acute inflammation, also the skin and blood pressure. Keep a light diet and calm routine; for emergencies such as sudden high fever or severe pain, seek care at once without waiting.
cnDesc: 廉贞属火，在疾厄宫多指向血液、心火与急性炎症，也提示皮肤、血压方面；平时清淡作息、少燥，遇到突发高热、剧痛等急症要立即就医，别观望。

cnTitle: 天府在疾厄宫：胃口好是把双刃剑，吃多了脾胃受累
enTitle: Tian Fu in the Health Palace: A Good Appetite Can Overload
enDesc: Tian Fu belongs to earth, and in the Health Palace it also governs the spleen and stomach, often with a strong appetite and absorption; the constitution is steady, but an unchecked mouth leads to overeating, stagnation, weight and blood-sugar rises. Eat to seventy percent, keep balanced and regular, and do not indulge because you feel stable.
cnDesc: 天府属土，在疾厄宫同样主脾胃，且多胃口好、吸收强；体质较稳，但管不住嘴就容易过食、积食、体重与血糖走高，重在七分饱、均衡、规律，别恃稳而纵。

cnTitle: 太阴在疾厄宫：阴虚内分泌偏敏感，睡眠妇科多关照
enTitle: Tai Yin in the Health Palace: Yin Deficiency, Hormones, Sleep
enDesc: Tai Yin belongs to water, and in the Health Palace it often points to kidney yin, hormones, gynecology, sleep and the eyes. Yin deficiency with heat, menstrual or sleep disturbance are common; avoid staying up which consumes yin, keep emotions steady and seek specialist care for gynecological or hormonal abnormalities.
cnDesc: 太阴属水，在疾厄宫多指向肾阴、内分泌、妇科与睡眠、眼睛；易阴虚燥热、月经或睡眠失调，重在别熬夜耗阴、情绪平稳，妇科与内分泌异常要专科就诊。

cnTitle: 贪狼在疾厄宫：应酬欲望要有度，肝胆与内分泌多关照
enTitle: Tan Lang in the Health Palace: Moderation for Liver and Hormones
enDesc: Tan Lang belongs to wood and carries romance; in the Health Palace it often points to the liver-gallbladder, urinary-reproductive system and hormones. Strong desires, social indulgence and loose routines bring trouble most easily; restraint and regularity matter, so do not squander the body on quick recovery.
cnDesc: 贪狼属木、带桃花，在疾厄宫多指向肝胆、泌尿生殖与内分泌；多欲、多应酬、作息放纵时最易出问题，重在节制、规律，别仗着恢复快就挥霍身体。

cnTitle: 巨门在疾厄宫：口腔咽喉是门户，疑病多虑更伤身
enTitle: Ju Men in the Health Palace: Mouth, Throat and Worry
enDesc: Ju Men belongs to water and is the dark star; in the Health Palace it often points to the mouth, throat, teeth and gut, and one may grow suspicious or anxious, turning small ills into feared diseases. Guard what enters the mouth, ease emotions, and settle doubts through tests rather than guessing.
cnDesc: 巨门属水、为暗星，在疾厄宫多指向口腔、咽喉、牙齿与肠胃，也容易多疑、焦虑、把小毛病想成大病；重在管好入口、疏解情绪，有疑虑靠检查而非瞎猜。

cnTitle: 天相在疾厄宫：饮食有节养皮肤，淋巴泌尿多留意
enTitle: Tian Xiang in the Health Palace: Diet, Skin and Lymph
enDesc: Tian Xiang belongs to water and is the seal star; in the Health Palace it often points to the urinary kidneys, skin and lymph, often tied to diet, clothing and daily rhythm. The constitution is generally steady; eat with restraint, keep clean and do not follow fads with tonics.
cnDesc: 天相属水、为印星，在疾厄宫多指向泌尿肾、皮肤与淋巴，多与饮食、衣着、生活节律相关；体质总体平稳，重在饮食有节、清洁到位、不跟风乱吃补品。

cnTitle: 天梁在疾厄宫：逢凶有救别侥幸，慢病调养贵坚持
enTitle: Tian Liang in the Health Palace: Chronic Care and Consistency
enDesc: Tian Liang belongs to earth and is the shelter star; in the Health Palace it often governs the spleen and stomach and suggests turning misfortune around. Yet because one always pulls through, acute ills are easily dragged into chronic ones. Seek early care without relying on luck; chronic ills need steady care and follow-up.
cnDesc: 天梁属土、为荫星，在疾厄宫多主脾胃，且有逢凶化吉之意；但正因「总能扛过去」，容易把急性拖成慢性。重在早就医、不侥幸，慢病靠规律调养与随访。

cnTitle: 七杀在疾厄宫：起病急猛别硬扛，外伤防护要到位
enTitle: Qi Sha in the Health Palace: Acute Onset and Injury Care
enDesc: Qi Sha belongs to metal and governs sternness; in the Health Palace it often points to the lungs, respiratory tract and injury, with sudden and forceful onset. Protect daily, prevent injury in sport and work, and seek decisive emergency care without waiting.
cnDesc: 七杀属金、主肃杀，在疾厄宫多指向肺、呼吸道与外伤，起病常急、来势猛；重在日常防护、运动劳作防外伤，急症当机立断就医，一刻都别观望。

cnTitle: 破军在疾厄宫：旧疾反复别大意，变动期重牙骨与复查
enTitle: Po Jun in the Health Palace: Recurring ills, Teeth and Bones
enDesc: Po Jun belongs to water and governs depletion and change; in the Health Palace it often points to teeth, bones and recurring ills, especially during big life changes. Keep routines steady in transitions, recheck old ills diligently, and follow professional advice when formal treatment including surgery is needed.
cnDesc: 破军属水、主耗与变动，在疾厄宫多指向牙齿、骨骼与旧疾反复，生活大变动时尤为明显；重在变动期稳住作息、旧患勤复查，需要正规治疗（含手术）时听专业意见。

cnTitle: 左辅在疾厄宫：恢复有助力，却别因有人照顾而大意
enTitle: Zuo Fu in the Health Palace: Good Recovery, No Complacency
enDesc: Zuo Fu belongs to earth and is a support star; in the Health Palace it suggests care from others during illness and fairly good recovery. But support can ease vigilance and skip rechecks; while grateful for care, still follow doctor orders and do not stop medicine on your own.
cnDesc: 左辅属土、为助力星，在疾厄宫多提示病中有人照护、恢复力较好；但助力容易让人放松警惕、忽视复查。重在感恩照护之余，仍按医嘱、不擅自停药。

cnTitle: 右弼在疾厄宫：情志有陪伴，养病别忘心情也需照料
enTitle: You Bi in the Health Palace: Companionship and Emotional Care
enDesc: You Bi belongs to water and is a support star; in the Health Palace it suggests companionship and emotional comfort during illness, aiding recovery. Yet emotional reliance can overshadow proper treatment. Treat body and mind together, and beyond companionship still follow the doctor.
cnDesc: 右弼属水、为助力星，在疾厄宫多提示病中得陪伴、情志有慰藉，利于康复；但也易因情绪依赖而忽视规范治疗。重在身心同治，陪伴之外仍听医生的。

cnTitle: 文昌在疾厄宫：用脑过度最伤身，神经与呼吸道多放松
enTitle: Wen Chang in the Health Palace: Overthinking, Nerves and Respiratory
enDesc: Wen Chang belongs to metal and governs reason and documents; in the Health Palace it points to nervous tension and overthinking, also the bronchial tract. The more meticulous and late-night the mental work, the easier insomnia and dry cough. Leave the mind blank space and relax nerves with breathing and exercise.
cnDesc: 文昌属金、主理性文书，在疾厄宫多指向神经紧张、用脑过度，也连带支气管；人越较真、越熬夜动脑，越容易失眠、干咳。重在给大脑留白、用呼吸和运动松神经。

cnTitle: 文曲在疾厄宫：情志起伏牵动身体，养心即是养身
enTitle: Wen Qu in the Health Palace: Emotions and the Body
enDesc: Wen Qu belongs to water and governs feeling and talent; in the Health Palace it points to bodily reactions from emotional imbalance, such as chest tightness, poor sleep and gut upset; the body responds as emotions move. Ease the mood and give feelings an outlet.
cnDesc: 文曲属水、主感性才情，在疾厄宫多指向情志失调带来的身体反应，如胸闷、睡眠差、肠胃不适；情绪一波动身体就跟着应。重在疏解心情、给感受找出口。

cnTitle: 天官在命宫：稳重自持带贵气，端着别让自己太累
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Life Palace: Steady Dignity Without Strain
enDesc: Tian Guan governs dignity and steadiness; in the Life Palace one is upright, self-possessed and presentable, giving a sense of reliability. Yet one may stand on ceremony, care about face and add pressure. Keep steadiness while learning to relax, without needing constant perfection.
cnDesc: 天官主贵气、稳重，在命宫多为人端正、自持、讲体面，给人可靠感；但也容易端着、爱面子、给自己加压。重在守住稳重的同时，学会放松、不必时刻完美。

cnTitle: 天官在兄弟宫：手足同辈多端正，相处贵乎真诚尊重
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Siblings Palace: Upright Peers and Mutual Respect
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Siblings Palace suggests siblings and peers are upright and fairly reliable, able to offer help. Yet relations lean on propriety and can feel formal. Interact sincerely, respect one another and discuss matters openly.
cnDesc: 天官在兄弟宫多主兄弟姐妹、同辈朋友品行端正、较为可靠，能得同辈之助；但关系也偏讲分寸、略显客气。重在真诚往来、彼此尊重，遇事好商量。

cnTitle: 天官在夫妻宫：伴侣端正稳重，相处重尊重与责任感
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Spouse Palace: A Steady Partner and Respect
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Spouse Palace suggests an upright, steady and responsible partner, with a calm and grounded relationship. It may feel less romantic and a bit serious. Respect one another, share responsibility and build warmth within the ordinary.
cnDesc: 天官在夫妻宫多主伴侣品行端正、稳重可靠、有责任感，关系偏平稳踏实；但也可能少些浪漫、略显严肃。重在彼此尊重、共同担责，平淡中经营温度。

cnTitle: 天官在子女宫：子女多乖顺端正，教养重身教与尊重
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Children Palace: Well-Behaved Children and Example
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Children Palace suggests well-behaved, mannerly and upright children, with a fairly disciplined bond. Over-strict control can make them reserved. Lead by example, respect their nature and combine rules with warmth.
cnDesc: 天官在子女宫多主子女乖顺、有教养、较为端正，亲子关系偏规矩；但管束过严易显拘谨。重在以身作则、尊重孩子天性，规矩与温度并施。

cnTitle: 天官在财帛宫：财源偏稳、取之有道，守正比冒进更长久
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Wealth Palace: Steady, Principled Income
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Wealth Palace suggests steady, principled income built through duty and reputation; speculation and greedy haste do not suit. Stay upright and measure capacity, for steady accumulation is more grounded than sudden profit.
cnDesc: 天官在财帛宫多主财源较稳、取之正道，靠本分与信誉积累；不适合投机取巧、贪快冒进。重在守正、量力，稳稳积累比一时暴利踏实。

cnTitle: 天官在疾厄宫：调养偏稳、重视体面，慢病也要规范随访
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Health Palace: Steady Care and Follow-Up
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Health Palace suggests a fairly steady constitution and slower illness, yet one cares about face and may avoid doctors or tough it out. Set hesitation aside, care properly and keep chronic follow-up on time, not delaying for face.
cnDesc: 天官在疾厄宫多主体质偏稳、病势较缓，但人爱体面、有时讳疾忌医或硬撑。重在放下顾虑、规范调养，慢病按时随访，别因面子耽误。

cnTitle: 天官在迁移宫：外出多遇贵人，在外体面也需守分寸
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Travel Palace: Dignity and Help Away From Home
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Travel Palace suggests dignity away from home and upright mentors, favoring travel, relocation and outside development. Still keep proper conduct and reputation. Be poised and measure capacity, for mentors add to, not replace, your effort.
cnDesc: 天官在迁移宫多主在外有体面、易遇正派贵人，利远行、外派、外出发展；但外出仍要守规矩、重信誉。重在大方得体、量力而行，贵人是加分、不是替代。

cnTitle: 天官在仆役宫：朋友部属多端正，交友重品择善而交
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Friends Palace: Upright Friends and Staff
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Friends Palace suggests upright, reliable friends and staff, able to offer support. The circle values character and standards. Choose good company, lead with sincerity and know people as well as boundaries.
cnDesc: 天官在仆役（交友）宫多主朋友、部属品行端正、较为可靠，能得众人之助；但圈子也偏讲品、重门槛。重在择善而交、真诚带人，知人亦知边界。

cnTitle: 天官在田宅宫：家宅安稳有体面，置产宜居宜量力
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Property Palace: A Steady, Dignified Home
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Property Palace suggests a steady, dignified home and upright family relations, favoring steady property purchase and settling. Property is a major matter; measure capacity and stay compliant, not overspending for face.
cnDesc: 天官在田宅宫多主家宅安稳、家居有体面，与家人关系端正，利于稳步置业、安顿；但置产是大事，重在量力、合规，不被面子推着超支。

cnTitle: 天官在福德宫：心性端正易知足，享福也需会放松
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Blessings Palace: Contentment and Ease
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Blessings Palace suggests an upright, content and steady mind with inner dignity, easily at peace with the present. One may be too proper to enjoy life. Accept yourself, learn to relax, and a calm heart is blessing.
cnDesc: 天官在福德宫多主心性端正、知足稳重，精神上有贵气、易安于当下；但也可能过于端着、不太会享乐。重在接纳自己、学会放松，心安即是福。

cnTitle: 天官在父母宫：长辈端正多庇荫，孝敬也需会沟通
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Parents Palace: Upright Elders and Communication
enDesc: Tian Guan in the Parents Palace suggests upright, steady parents and elders, able to offer shelter and support. The two generations may lean on propriety and feel distant. Be filial and grateful, communicate actively, both understanding and expressing.
cnDesc: 天官在父母宫多主父母、长辈品行端正、较为稳重，能得长辈庇荫与提携；但两代偏讲规矩、易有距离。重在孝敬感恩、主动沟通，理解也表达。

cnTitle: 大耗在兄弟宫：手足人情易消耗，情深也要守边界
enTitle: Da Hao in the Siblings Palace: Warm Kinship With Clear Boundaries
enDesc: Da Hao in the Siblings Palace suggests worry and effort spent on siblings and peers, with social obligations, help and standing up for others draining heart and money. Warm kinship is real, but unclear boundaries easily burden you. Help within capacity, keep boundaries, and aid emergencies rather than chronic dependence.
cnDesc: 大耗在兄弟宫，多主为兄弟姐妹、同辈朋友操心费神，人情往来、帮衬出头最耗心力钱财；情深是真，但边界不清就容易被拖累。重在量力帮衬、守好边界，救急不救穷。

cnTitle: 大耗在夫妻宫：感情里易有消耗，会经营才不被磨淡
enTitle: Da Hao in the Spouse Palace: Preventing Emotional Depletion
enDesc: Da Hao in the Spouse Palace suggests depletion of energy and heart in the relationship, easily tiring or fading over time, often from score-keeping, inner friction and neglect. Understand one another, communicate in time and turn depletion into nourishment.
cnDesc: 大耗在夫妻宫多主感情中易有精力与心力的消耗，久了易累、易淡；多来自计较、内耗与疏于经营。重在彼此体谅、及时沟通，把消耗转成滋养。

cnTitle: 大耗在子女宫：为子女易过度操心，放手也是一种爱
enTitle: Da Hao in the Children Palace: Over-Worry and Letting Go
enDesc: Da Hao in the Children Palace suggests much worry and heart spent on children, easily over-investing with anxious control; their matters drain the parents spirit. Do your best without overstepping, guide without taking over, and care for yourself first.
cnDesc: 大耗在子女宫多主为子女操心、耗费心力较多，容易过度投入、包办焦虑；孩子的事也消耗父母的精神。重在尽心而不越界、引导而不包办，先照顾好自己。

cnTitle: 大耗在官禄宫：事业易空耗精力，找对方法比蛮干强
enTitle: Da Hao in the Career Palace: Avoiding Empty Effort
enDesc: Da Hao in the Career Palace suggests much effort poured into work with little result, busy on trifles and drained by ineffective striving. Review regularly, focus on priorities and learn to leverage help, directing energy toward output.
cnDesc: 大耗在官禄宫多主事业上精力投入多、却易劳而少功，忙在琐事、消耗在无效努力；重在定期复盘、抓重点、会借力，把劲使在产出上。

cnTitle: 大耗在迁移宫：在外奔波易损耗，出行规划要做足
enTitle: Da Hao in the Travel Palace: Plan Trips to Cut Loss
enDesc: Da Hao in the Travel Palace suggests loss of time, money or energy during trips and rushing about, such as changed plans, overspending or fruitless travel. Plan ahead, leave margin and prepare contingencies to keep unexpected loss low.
cnDesc: 大耗在迁移宫多主外出、奔波中易有时间、金钱或精力的损耗，如临时改程、超支、白跑；重在出行前规划、留余量、备预案，把意外损耗降到低。

cnTitle: 大耗在福德宫：精神易被琐事耗尽，养心要会断舍离
enTitle: Da Hao in the Blessings Palace: Guarding Mental Energy
enDesc: Da Hao in the Blessings Palace suggests mental energy drained by trifles, stray thoughts and over-worry, feeling heart-tired despite doing little. Subtract, let go and leave the mind blank, reserving limited heart for what and who matter.
cnDesc: 大耗在福德宫多主精神能量易被琐事、杂念和过度思虑消耗，明明没做什么却心累；重在做减法、断舍离、给心神留白，把有限的心力留给要紧的人和事。

cnTitle: 天空在官禄宫：想法多易落空，事业要落地务实
enTitle: Tian Kong in the Career Palace: Grounding Ideas in Reality
enDesc: Tian Kong in the Career Palace suggests many fresh ideas that may stay conceptual with weak execution, and work leaning spiritual or changeable. Break visions into executable steps and validate in small moves so creativity truly delivers.
cnDesc: 天空在官禄宫多主想法多、点子新，却易停在构想、落地不足，事业也偏精神性或多变动；重在把空想拆成可执行的步骤、小步验证，让创意真正变现。

cnTitle: 天空在田宅宫：居家置产易有变数，决策宜稳看合同
enTitle: Tian Kong in the Property Palace: Cautious, Contract-Safe Decisions
enDesc: Tian Kong in the Property Palace suggests variables in home, moving or purchase, plans overtaken by change, and perhaps idealized expectations. Decide practically with margin, use formal channels, read contracts and avoid impulsive buying.
cnDesc: 天空在田宅宫多主居家、搬迁或置产易有变数、计划赶不上变化，也可能对家居有理想化期待；重在决策务实、留余地，走正规途径、看清合同，不冲动置业。

cnTitle: 天空在福德宫：精神世界丰富，心安也要落到日常
enTitle: Tian Kong in the Blessings Palace: Rich Inner Life, Grounded Peace
enDesc: Tian Kong in the Blessings Palace suggests a rich inner life, loving philosophy and imagination with strong intuition. One may drift, feel inexplicably empty or ungrounded. Land spiritual seeking in daily small things, relationships and action for stable peace.
cnDesc: 天空在福德宫多主精神世界丰富、好哲思与想象，直觉强；但也容易飘、易莫名空虚、不接地气。重在把精神追求落到日常小事、关系和行动里，内心才安稳。

cnTitle: 解神在疾厄宫：逢病有解是好事，规范治疗仍不能省
enTitle: Jie Shen in the Health Palace: Good Recovery, Proper Treatment
enDesc: Jie Shen governs resolving and dispelling misfortune; in the Health Palace it suggests illness eases, rescue comes and recovery is smooth. Being resolvable does not mean no treatment. Seek early care, treat properly and recheck on time, combining good fortune with science.
cnDesc: 解神主化解、消灾，在疾厄宫多提示病势易缓解、逢凶有救、恢复较顺；但「能解」不等于不用治。重在早就医、规范治疗、按时复查，把好运和科学结合。

cnTitle: 解神在财帛宫：破财纠纷多能化解，处理走正规途径
enTitle: Jie Shen in the Wealth Palace: Resolving Loss Through Proper Channels
enDesc: Jie Shen in the Wealth Palace suggests room to resolve financial loss and disputes, misfortune able to ease. Resolution relies on proper channels and kept records, not private force. Handle calmly, by law and contract, and communicate in time.
cnDesc: 解神在财帛宫多提示破财、财务纠纷多有化解转圜的余地，逢凶能缓；但化解要靠正规途径、留好凭据，而非私下硬来。重在冷静处理、依法依约、及时沟通。
